name: Layered Codecs
description: The neutral LayeredImage (pixel layers with offset, opacity, blend mode, visibility, clipping and a placed mask, nested groups, the merged composite) and CodecError; the PixelCodec protocol apps plug their PNG codec into, with RawPixelCodec as the lossless test stand-in; the PSD and OpenRaster entry points and limits, stubs that throw unsupported until the readers and writers land.
